c.v: Four independent pulse counters (units) that count from 1 to 65535
Each unit consists of two independent channels sharing one pulse counter
All channels have input pulse signals (e.g., sig_ch0_u
) with their corresponding control signals (e.g., ctrl_ch0_u
Independently filter glitches of input pulse signals (sig_ch0_u
Each channel has the following parameters:
Selection between counting on positive or negative edges of the input pulse signal
Configuration to Increment, Decrement, or Disable counter mode for control signal's high and low states
